note: Plan 0009, R16: the start points of the web build (the URL parameter start=ID). A start stands on the point of a road nearest to its landmark (landmark, and road: the name of the road, else any street), or on the middle of a road or of its OSM way (road, way), and faces the landmark or the way of the road. The game reads them with --start=ID too.
